newsitem.title: UK: UK tour operators increase summer 1997 programmes.
newsitem.headline: UK tour operators increase summer 1997 programmes.

text.p: Britain's tour operators have increased by 15 percent the number of flights they have arranged under licence for the summer holiday season, the Civil Aviation Authority said on Thursday.

Almost 16 million Air Travel Organises' Licences (ATOL) have been granted for the summer. Winter carryings increased 12 percent to 8.4 million. In the full year to end-March 1997, there were 21.6 million passengers covered by ATOLs.
"The winter market was strong in both volume and price, and summer programmes now suggest much more optimism among tour operators than earlier in the year," the CAA said.
